entityTypes.name: cell
entityTypes.description: One recorded neuron. The data descriptor: 'Cell identity code includes the date, the cell number and the cell type, joined with the underscore symbol, e.g. 160118_c10_D2 means cell 10 expressing D2 dopamine receptor, recorded Jan 18 2016.'

entityTypes.name: experiment
entityTypes.description: One recording session with several neurons patched together. The data descriptor: 'Experiment identity code includes the date, the range of cell numbers and the list of cell types, joined with the underscore symbol, e.g. 150917_c9_11_D1_D1_D2 means cells 9-11 expressing D1, D1 and D2 dopamine receptor, respectively, recorded Sep 17 2015.'

cell_id.name: cell_id
cell_id.title: Cell identity
cell_id.description: Name of the cell's folder, as the data descriptor's <identity>.

recording_date.name: recording_date
recording_date.title: Recording date
recording_date.description: The first six digits of the identity, yymmdd.

dopamine_receptor.name: dopamine_receptor
dopamine_receptor.title: Dopamine receptor
dopamine_receptor.description: D1 or D2, the last part of the cell identity.

experiment_id.name: experiment_id
experiment_id.title: Experiment identity
experiment_id.description: Name of the experiment's folder in original/.

dataLocations.description: Kozlov et al., electrophysiological recordings of striatal projection neurons (dataset version e0cfa3fb-22d2-48c7-bb4c-a6374bfc848b, bucket pc0a33-hbp-d000003_SPN-ephys_pub). The data descriptor's layout is 2019Q3/<cell type>/<analysis|derived|original>/<identity>; this location is the analysis branch of 2019Q3, with one root per cell-type folder (dspn, ispn), and holds the extracted features and the feature extraction notebook per cell. Every entry below the roots was listed.

Kozlov et al., electrophysiological recordings of striatal projection neurons (dataset version e0cfa3fb-22d2-48c7-bb4c-a6374bfc848b, bucket pc0a33-hbp-d000003_SPN-ephys_pub). The data descriptor's layout is 2019Q3/<cell type>/<analysis|derived|original>/<identity>; this location is the derived branch of 2019Q3, with one root per cell-type folder (dspn, ispn), and holds the derived traces per cell, ASCII text. Every entry below the roots was listed.

filePatterns.name: traces
filePatterns.description: One trace per channel and sweep, <condition>_<protocol>_ch<N>_<sweep>. Even channels hold the current in pA, odd channels the voltage in mV; time in ms.
